note: The only allowed issue labels and board options (FR-DEV-10, US-DEV-05). Every issue carries exactly one type label and one epic label from this file. A new type or epic is a pull request to this file that the owner merges. Board options: the field Typ matches its option name exactly; the field Epic and Priority match the option whose name starts with the code (for example ACC matches the option "ACC · …"), so the option texts of the board stay out of this file. An epic whose board option does not start with its code names that option in `option` (E: decisions E-nn, TE: platform enablers TE-nn; owner decision 2026-11-04).
